about: Shape by gradient descent (G1, phase 1, 2026-11-07). Sources for the rest pose, the passive finger stiffness, the press forces and the reference shapes; every derived number names its inputs. Code: deck/tools/gd/.

sts57.title: Mount, Whitmore & Stealey, Evaluation of Neutral Body Posture on Shuttle Mission STS-57 (SPACEHAB-1), NASA/TM-2003-104805 (2003)

figures.msis_nbp: MSIS NBP lists wrist 0 / 0, elbow 90, shoulder flexion 36
figures.quote: in a forward position with the fingers curled at the knuckles (crew 2, p. 8)

sts57.used_for: The rest pose in orbit: wrist straight; the fingers' flexion (mean 41 deg, 21 to 60) checked against the cascade's knuckle-to-tip angle (45 to 54 deg). Skylab is the MSIS's original source (cited by the TM); the TM itself says no one crew member showed the MSIS posture.

leejung.title: K.-S. Lee & M.-C. Jung, Flexion and Extension Angles of Resting Fingers and Wrist, Int. J. Occupational Safety and Ergonomics 20(1) (2014) 91-101, doi:10.1080/10803548.2014.11077038

figures.condition: forearm neutral, resting fingers, 40 participants, Vicon

leejung.used_for: The relaxed cascade, the rest pose's finger angles (the forearm-neutral condition, whose wrist is closest to the 0 deg in orbit).

varghese.title: Varghese, Venugopal, Srinivasan & Geetha Hari Priya, A Study on the Normative Values of Finger Flexion Cascade in Power Grip Users and Non-power Grip Users, JCDR 14(5) (2020) YC01-YC07
varghese.used_for: Cross-check of the cascade (software workers' resting hands): within about 10 deg of Lee & Jung.

ansur2.title: ANSUR II public data, men (n = 4,082)
ansur2.used_for: The reference hand (the deck's ruler, b07_size); middle finger from the palm crease = 193.3 - 116.5 = 76.8 mm scales the bone lengths.

buryanov.title: Buryanov & Kotiuk, Proportions of Hand Segments, Int. J. Morphol. (2010), as tabulated in Design, Implementation and Control of an Underactuated Hand Exoskeleton (arXiv 2003.11598), table 'Average finger phalange sizes'
buryanov.used_for: Finger bone lengths, scaled by 1.052 to the ANSUR II mean hand (derived). Read through a secondary source: to verify against the 2010 paper before slides.

shi2020.title: Shi, Heung, Tang, Tong & Li, Verification of Finger Joint Stiffness Estimation Method With Soft Robotic Actuator, Frontiers in Bioengineering and Biotechnology 8 (2020) 592637
shi2020.used_for: The finger's own pull back to rest: k_tip = k / r^2 (derived). Flexion stiffness also stands in for side-to-side (abduction) stiffness at the knuckle: an assumption.

kuo2012.title: Kuo & Deshpande, Muscle-tendon units provide limited contributions to the passive stiffness of the index finger metacarpophalangeal joint, J. Biomech. 45(15) (2012) 2531-2538

figures.finding: the capsule-ligament complex, not the muscles, gives most of the passive stiffness

kuo2012.used_for: Range check; why the stiffness is passive (ligaments), present with no muscle effort.

milner1998.title: Milner & Franklin, Characterization of multijoint finger stiffness, IEEE TBME 45(11) (1998) 1363-1375

figures.relaxed: 20 % MVC gives 2 to 4 times the relaxed finger's maximum stiffness

milner1998.used_for: Context: a working finger is far stiffer than a relaxed one, so the relaxed value is the right one for a finger at rest.

johnson2000.title: Johnson, Hagberg, Wigaeus Hjelm & Rempel, Measuring and characterizing force exposure during computer mouse use, Scand J Work Environ Health 26(5) (2000) 398-405

figures.note: The abstract prints 'sides and button ... 0.6 % (0.35 N) and 0.8 % (0.43 N)'; the results text gives the sides as 0.43 (SD 0.13) N and Table 2's button column 0.35 (SD 0.06) N. This study uses the table and text. Office work, not gaming.

johnson2000.used_for: The press N that turns a pocket's slope into a sideways hold: 0.35 N on the buttons, 0.43 N squeeze on the sides (0.92 N in simulated use).

tpu_ulx.title: TechPowerUp, Finalmouse UltralightX review, page 3 (shape)

quotes: the sides do curve in, but essentially are straight at the middle
Neither the front nor back flare out much
The main buttons feature rather deep comfort grooves

tpu_ulx.used_for: The ULX's pockets: 2.5 mm per side in from the hump, 1.1 mm per side of front flare (derived from the widths), and its deep grooves.

elo_sora.title: EloShapes spec sheet, Ninjutso Sora V2 (research/data/mice.json)
elo_sora.used_for: Cross-check of the GLB: 119.41 x 62.56 x 37.47 mm (derived from 3d/shell/shell-sora.glb).

sora_widths_from_glb_mm.note: right side (no side buttons), half widths: hump 31.11 at z -20, waist 29.87 at z 9.9, front 30.15 at z 30; the Sora's waist is 1.2 mm in from the hump and 0.27 mm under the front

params: pocket centre s (mm along the plan from the nose)
groove centre s (mm along the section from the top)
